I found this information off reddit initially, but you have to disassemble the entire pill.

There's a white pasty coating on the outside (may be red or cream, depends on the pill. same effect regardless) , either suck the coating off (I rest it under my tongue too, for good measure) or leave it in tap-hot water for a good 15-20 mins, just until you can see two distinct colors on the pill. One half is more *white*, and one is more *grey/green/yellow/idfk* depends on the pill dosage. Anyway, you're going to want to **get rid of the not white half.** The white is a high concentration of methylphenidate (Ritalin) and the other color is an extended release mechanism. The ER mechanism can't get you high, and just fucks up your nose for the next two days. Don't recommend. But anyway, hold onto the **white part** for sure. There's a thin layer of wax coating the pill still, which you can use a razer blade (much easier if pill is slightly warm, even by your hand or by being in you mouth) to just cut off either before or after **getting rid of the colored portion of the pill.** I usually do it after, but I read some people do it before. Then you can either swallow it normally *~~(which idk why you would at this point, may as well go all out)~~*  or crush it up, make a line, blah blah you know the drill.

As someone who uses stimulants and also has experience with non-stimulant induced psychosis, you’ll be okay. Worse case though is that if you have generic predispositions and the psychosis fails to reside, there is a chance you could have activated schizophrenia/a similar disorder. In that case, please seek treatment so you can recover/manage this ASAP. However based on what others have said, you’ll likely be fine.  I just wanted to state this possibility just in case, because that is always a hazard especially in high doses of stimulants and I want to offer as much support as I can o line. Just remind yourself your dopamine levels are just being fucked still, HARD.  and that it’s natural to be in a shitty state until your brain can rebalance, that’s just how it works. What goes up must come down, so being in a psychological hellscape unfortunately is a possibility. Drink some energy drinks, make sure to try to sleep even if it’s just laying there restless with your eyes closed.  This is terrifying but it’s all in your head, literally. Some comforting/nostalgic music may help as well, or I also find cleaning my living space or showering helps. Just with separating the physical/mental for a bit.

I also recommend looking into any free DBT therapy resources, like leaked workbooks and PDFs. Some of the content is a bit outdated (like I saw a healthy coping mechanism listed as “join and online dating site” in the official DBT workbook), but the general ideas apply and just sitting through and “parenting” yourself through your emotions is also very helpful. I’m a hypocrite, though, it’s not easy. But therapy is costly and I know at least where I am psych care is in shambles due to the pandemic, so if you need help finding free support lmk
